```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
penguins
```

```{r}
colnames(penguins)
```

```{r}
dim(penguins)
```

```{r}
View(penguins)
```

```{r}
?penguins
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins) +
  geom_density(mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, fill = species), alpha = .5)
  
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins) +
  geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) + 
  facet_wrap(~species, nrow=3)
```
